    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find full straight separator of color 2.
    sep_r = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if sep_r is not None:

        # The object can be holes in the dominant background (for example zero in a 4 field).
        if not pts:
            other=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=2).most_common()
            if other:
                color=other[-1][0]
                pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if pts:
            r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
            c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
            shape=[(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r,c in pts]

            for r in range(r0,r1+1):

        return out

            for dr,dc,v in shape: out[r0+dr][nc+dc]=v
            mark=nc+(c1-c0)+1 if nc>sep_c else nc-1
            if 0<=mark<w:
                for r in range(h): out[r][mark]=8
        return out
    return out
''')
